title: Manipur Naga body demands NIA probe into Ukhrul killings, Kuki rebels’ removal

ai.summary: A Naga civil society group in Manipur demanded a National Investigation Agency probe into four civilians killed in Ukhrul and called for Kuki rebels to be removed from Naga areas, following multiple killings by armed assailants.

facts.claim: A Naga organisation in conflict-scarred Manipur has issued a three-day “public ultimatum” to the Union and State governments to drive out Kuki rebels from Naga areas and let the National Investigation Agency probe the killing of four Naga civilians in Ukhrul district on Friday (November 13, 2026).
facts.quote: A Naga organisation in conflict-scarred Manipur has issued a three-day “public ultimatum” to the Union and State governments to drive out Kuki rebels from Naga areas and let the National Investigation Agency probe the killing of four Naga civilians in Ukhrul district on Friday (November 13, 2026).

facts.claim: The four, identified as Kapangkhui R.S., her son Haoleila R.S., Khanmila Keishing and August Ngalung, all from Ukhrul district, were killed when armed assailants ambushed two vehicles on National Highway-202.
facts.quote: The four, identified as Kapangkhui R.S., her son Haoleila R.S., Khanmila Keishing and August Ngalung, all from Ukhrul district, were killed when armed assailants ambushed two vehicles on National Highway-202.

facts.claim: The four Naga civilians were killed a day after a Kuki woman was killed and two Kuki men were injured in a similar firing incident in Kangpokpi district.
facts.quote: The four Naga civilians were killed a day after a Kuki woman was killed and two Kuki men were injured in a similar firing incident in Kangpokpi district.

facts.claim: Tangkhul Naga Long (TNL), an apex Naga organisation, said the Naga people have lost complete faith in the Central security forces, and all Central security forces deployed on that stretch of the road must be immediately withdrawn.
facts.quote: Stating that the Naga people have lost complete faith in the Central security forces, the TNL said all Central security forces deployed on that stretch of the road must be immediately withdrawn.

facts.claim: The victim families resolved not to claim the bodies until then. Failing this, it is resolved that the general public would be compelled to resort to an indefinite agitation until complete justice is delivered.
facts.quote: The victim families resolved not to claim the bodies until then. Failing this, it is resolved that the general public would be compelled to resort to an indefinite agitation until complete justice is delivered,

ai.background_note: The Naga people in Manipur have lost faith in Central security forces after multiple killings by armed groups, leading to a public ultimatum demanding a probe into recent civilian deaths and removal of Kuki rebels from Naga areas.
